cases.case_label: Noncoding retrotransposon insertion in an XLID family (gene not named in abstract)
cases.mechanism_detail: One of three XLID pedigrees had a pathogenic noncoding retrotransposon insertion confirmed with RNA-seq/RT-PCR/Western/reporter assays; the gene and element are not specified in the abstract.
cases.quote: a retrotransposon insertion, a novel intronic splice donor, and a canonical splice variant of an untranslated exon
